# Overlays

Popover, tooltip, menu, modal and drawer.

[Popover](#popover) · [Tooltip](#tooltip) · [Menu](#menu) · [Modal](#modal) · [Drawer](#drawer)

### Popover

A floating panel anchored to a trigger. It flips and shifts to stay on screen. The base for date pickers and the grid menus.

```ts
import { Popover } from '@/kit/components/overlays/Popover'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` *(required)* | `ReactElement` |  | The element that opens it. It receives a ref plus aria and click props, so it must forward its ref. |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactNode \| (api: { close }) => ReactNode` |  | Panel content. A function receives `close`. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. Leave out for uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called when it wants to open or close. |
| `placement` | `Placement` | `'bottom-start'` | Floating UI placement. |
| `matchWidth` | `boolean` |  | Make the panel as wide as the trigger. |
| `initialFocus` | `number` | `0` | Index of the element to focus first; -1 leaves focus alone. |

```tsx
<Popover trigger={<Button variant="ghost">Notifications</Button>}>
  {({ close }) => <div className="stack-sm" style={{ padding: '1rem' }}>You are all caught up. <Button size="sm" onClick={close}>Close</Button></div>}
</Popover>
```

- Esc and outside click close it, focus returns to the trigger. Do not put a `Select` inside: its list is its own floating layer.

### Tooltip

A short label shown on hover and keyboard focus.

```ts
import { Tooltip } from '@/kit/components/overlays/Tooltip'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Tooltip text. |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactElement` |  | A single element that can take a ref. |
| `placement` | `Placement` | `'top'` | Preferred side. |

```tsx
<Tooltip label="Copies the account number"><Button icon aria-label="Copy"><Copy /></Button></Tooltip>
```

- For a short description only. Put interactive content in a Popover.

### Menu

A dropdown of actions with arrow-key navigation.

```ts
import { Menu } from '@/kit/components/overlays/Menu'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` *(required)* | `ReactElement` |  | The element that opens the menu. |
| `entries` *(required)* | `MenuEntry[]` |  | Items (`{ id, label, icon?, onSelect?, to?, danger? }`), `{ type: 'separator' }`, `{ type: 'label' }` and `{ type: 'custom', node }`. |
| `placement` | `Placement` | `'bottom-end'` | Preferred side. |

```tsx
<Menu trigger={<Button variant="ghost">Actions</Button>} entries={[
  { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', to: '/profile' },
  { type: 'separator', id: 's' },
  { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', danger: true, onSelect: remove },
]} />
```

- ↑ ↓ move (wrapping), Enter selects, Esc closes. Items with `to` render router links.

### Modal

A centered dialog that traps focus and locks page scroll.

```ts
import { Modal } from '@/kit/components/overlays/Modal'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` *(required)* | `boolean` |  | Whether it is shown. |
| `onClose` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called on Esc, outside click and the close button. |
| `title` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Heading, also the accessible name. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Text under the heading. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Body. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Buttons aligned to the bottom right. |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Width. |

```tsx
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Close this account?" actions={<Button variant="danger">Close account</Button>} />
```

- Focus returns to the element that opened it.

### Drawer

A modal side sheet.

```ts
import { Drawer } from '@/kit/components/overlays/Drawer'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` *(required)* | `boolean` |  | Whether it is shown. |
| `onClose` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called on Esc, outside click and the close button. |
| `title` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Heading. |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Body. |
| `side` | `'right' \| 'left'` | `'right'` | Edge it slides from. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` |  | Sticky footer content. |

```tsx
<Drawer open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Filters" footer={<Button>Apply</Button>}>…</Drawer>
```

- For a non-blocking side panel see `ThemeDock`.
